featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Leaving a 4-year-old child unattended and letting him walk home alone crossing roads is apparently “normal” here.

We dropped our son for Taekwondo class at 7 PM, and when my husband went to pick him up at 8 PM, our child was MISSING. Nobody there knew where he was. Imagine the panic of parents searching everywhere for their 4-year-old.

Later, we found out he had somehow reached home ALONE by himself, crossing roads without any adult supervision. A FOUR-YEAR-OLD.

What’s even more shocking is the management’s response. We asked for CCTV footage, and till now there has been no proper response. The owner seemed more interested in attending his meeting than addressing a serious child safety issue. Even when he finally came, instead of waiting to speak with us, he casually left.

Thank you for teaching us that “child safety” is clearly not a priority here. Parents, please think twice before trusting this place with your children.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining Nalas Swimming Class in Vasai completely changed my experience in regard to the approach of learning Swimming. Under the excellent guidance of Coach Ninad, I was able to confidently perform freestyle swimming within just 8 sessions.

What truly makes Ninad different is the hands-on coaching approach, he personally gets into the pool, patiently demonstrates every movement in detail, corrects mistakes instantly, and ensures each student learns with proper technique and confidence rather than just “managing to swim.” The training environment is motivating, supportive, and highly professional.

customer_updates.name: Intekhab Bangi
customer_updates.text: "I recently joined this Asmita  club and I am absolutely loving it! The facilities are top-notch and the staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. There are a variety of classes and activities to choose from, so there's something for everyone. I highly recommend this club to anyone looking in Mira Road  to get active and have fun!"

featured_reviews.name: Dhruvi Makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
Individual can learn swimming from scratch to perfect basic swimming within 21 days. Every step suggested during the coaching is progressive step towards learning to swim. Coaches ensures individuals scared of depth gets comfortable with diving from the dive board as well. Pool is well maintained by the team.

Amazing way to train!! Highly Recommended!!

featured_reviews.name: lazeena shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Bless Sir is the best for my child when it comes to swimming. My child learned swimming very quickly, and that too very well. He’s the best coach — highly recommended! Asmita Club is great for swimming, and special thanks to Bless Sir.

featured_reviews.name: Sanika Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining Asmita Club for swimming has been a very positive experience.  I was afraid of getting into the water before I started lessons with the coach. After just a few classes, I started feeling confident that I could learn to swim.
Our sir Mr. Bless conducted swimming training in a very disciplined  and systematic manner. He explained each technique clearly and demonstrated it practically. He paid personal attention to every student and corrected our mistakes patiently. The training improved our swimming skills, confidence, and safety in water.  Over all, the swimming training was very helpful and enjoyable because of our Bless Sir's guidence.       Asmita Club provides excellent facilities for sports and physical training. The environment is clean, safe, and motivating. The trainers are skilled, supportive, and give proper guidance to all students. The club helps in improving physical fitness, discipline, and confidence. Overall, Asmita Club is a great place for learning and practicing sports activities.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Sanika,

It was a pleasure having you at Asmita Club! Thank you for sharing such a detailed and inspiring account of your experience. We are truly proud to hear how you overcame your fear of water and gained confidence so quickly.

We will be sure to share your kind words with Mr. Bless. Maintaining a clean, safe, and motivating environment for our members is our top priority, and we’re glad you enjoyed our facilities. We look forward to seeing you continue to excel in your sports and fitness activities with us!

— Team AsmitA Club

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Me and my niece joined Asmita Club swimming classes to overcome fear of deep water and to improve swimming strokes. But in the process, we ended up falling in love with the water! 💧

The experience was amazing — we both thoroughly enjoyed every session and noticed a real improvement in the technique and confidence. The coaches were always encouraging and patient and constantly reminded us about the basics “bubble kick” 😊. In panic, this is my new mantra 😇(think this can be used in every walk of life 😊)

A big thank you to all the coaches and Charlie Sir for his guidance, motivation and his superb adaptive methods for adults as well as kids. I truly feel empowered as this has to be in my top 3 achievements this year.

Looking forward to coming back soon hopefully for under water snorkel lesson ! I recommend the course to all the beginners and other levels too.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Nikita! We’re truly happy to know that your time at Asmita Club has been such a positive and confidence-building experience.

Charlie Sir and our coaching team will be delighted to hear your kind words. Knowing that you gained confidence and enjoyed the journey means a lot to us.

We’re proud of your progress and the dedication you’ve shown. Can’t wait to have you back at the club—your next swimming milestone is waiting!

— Team AsmitaA Club

featured_reviews.name: Shoaib Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I cannot express enough gratitude to the team at Ashmita club, and especially to Bless Sir, for the incredible transformation in my twin daughters.

​Before joining, both of my girls were absolutely scared of the water. Just getting them near the pool was a challenge. However, Bless Sir’s patience, gentle encouragement, and expert coaching changed everything. He understood their fears and worked with them at their own pace, building trust every step of the way.

​Today, my daughters don't just "tolerate" the water—they absolutely love swimming! Seeing them dive in with smiles on their faces is a joy I didn't think was possible just a few weeks ago.

​If you have children who are hesitant or fearful of swimming, I highly recommend this club. We feel so lucky to have found such a supportive environment. Thank you, Bless Sir, for your dedication and for giving my girls a skill they will enjoy for a lifetime!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Shoaib Patel,

We are truly touched by your kind words and so happy to hear about the ""incredible transformation"" of your twin daughters! Thank you for sharing such a wonderful success story.

There is nothing more rewarding for us than seeing our young swimmers dive in with confidence and smiles!

Thank you for choosing AsmitA Club and for recommending us to other parents. We look forward to seeing your daughters at the pool for many more happy sessions!

— Team AsmitA Club

featured_reviews.name: Najeeb Khot
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently joined Asmita Club for the 21-day basic swimming training session, and it was truly a wonderful experience. The structured 21-day program really helped me learn swimming step by step and build confidence in the water.

A special thanks to Charlie Sir for his excellent guidance. From teaching the very basics like bubbles to proper kicking techniques, his instructions were clear, patient, and extremely effective. Both Sir and the staff paid special attention to every learner, ensuring we were comfortable and progressing well.

I have asthma and also had a strong fear of deep water before joining. But with the right training, encouragement, and support, I gradually overcame my fear. Today, I genuinely love being in the water and enjoy swimming — something I never thought would be possible!

I would highly encourage anyone who wants to learn swimming, especially beginners or those who are afraid of water, to enroll in this course at Asmita Club. It’s absolutely worth it!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Najeeb,

It was truly a pleasure having you in our 21-day basic swimming training session! Thank you so much for sharing your inspiring journey with us. We will certainly pass on your ""special thanks"" to Charlie Sir; he takes great pride in helping beginners master the basics, from bubbles to kicking, with patience and care.

Your story will surely encourage others who are hesitant to start their own swimming journey.

— Team AsmitA Club.

featured_reviews.name: Sayaji Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended the Charlie Sit batch in the morning and it was a great experience!
• The coach was very attentive and encouraging throughout the session.
• Swimming facilities were available, which made the overall workout more fun and engaging.
• A trained swimming guard was present at the pool, so safety was well taken care of.
• The water quality was clean and well-maintained — no strong chlorine smell or irritation.
• The crowd was also well-managed and the session started on time.

Overall, a really enjoyable session!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Sayaji, thank you so much for sharing your experience with us!

We’re glad you enjoyed the Charlie Sit batch and that our trainer’s guidance, clean swimming facilities, and well-managed session made your workout enjoyable. It’s great to hear the pool conditions and overall environment met your expectations.

We truly appreciate your feedback and look forward to welcoming you back for many more energising sessions!

featured_reviews.name: hazel raj
featured_reviews.review_text: I was scared of swimming all my life, and then I joined Asmita club’s 21 days swimming Class with Bless sir and his team(Stanford,Surya and Vishal). And they are amazing at teaching you and to get the fear out of you. I am very happy on swimming for the first time in my life in 13ft deep pool. Thank you to the team keep up the good work.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Wow, what an incredible journey! We're so happy to hear that you overcame your fear and enjoyed swimming for the first time in a 13ft deep pool. Thank you for sharing your experience, and we’re so proud of your progress! Keep swimming and enjoying the water!" 😊🏊‍♀️💙

featured_reviews.name: Harshil Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training at Life Fitness Gym and it has been a genuinely great experience. The gym is well-equipped with all the essential machines and free weights needed for serious muscle building. Whether you're into strength training, hypertrophy workouts, or general fitness, you’ll find the right setup here.

The environment is motivating and focused. Trainers are approachable and guide you properly when needed, especially with form and workout structure. The equipment is maintained well, and there’s enough variety to train every muscle group effectively without feeling limited.

What I like most is that the gym atmosphere is serious but not intimidating. People come to work hard, and that energy helps a lot if you’re focused on gaining muscle and improving strength.

Overall, I honestly give it 5 stars. If your goal is muscle building and consistent progress, this gym is an excellent choice in Naigaon East.

featured_reviews.review_text: The facility is exceptionally well-equipped with highly competent trainers. It stands out as the only gymnasium offering a wide array of cardio activities. Mr. Pritesh, Mr. Ajay, Mr. Amar, and Mr. Shivam are all remarkably cooperative and dedicated to motivating individuals to achieve their fitness aspirations..

address: 9RQF+MPX, Ambadi Rd, Krishna Twp, Vasai West, Vasai-Virar, Maharashtra 401202

featured_reviews.name: M. Amol
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a very good half marathon swimming pool for all age group people with professional trainer and the charges of the 1 hour is only 50rs.

featured_reviews.name: Wasim Shaikh (Baava)
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is good for people of all ages. Pool size is from 4 feet to 7 feet. Descent crowd. Active lifeguard. The image below has details of when it is open for guests, non guests and ladies. Had great experience. Charges are RS. 50/ hr

featured_reviews.name: Neha Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text:
PLEASE NOTE
I visited the place today. This swimming pool  has been under repair for the past six months and remains inoperational. The estimated time for completion is still undecided. The operational timings are invalid. The mentioned contact number too is unreachable.

featured_reviews.name: Batika Rai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice pool. Good trainers. Clean changing rooms.
Water is clean. Except 2 batch rest are open fir guest.
They charge rupees 50/- per hour for guest.
You have to bring your costume.
They also sell costumes.
Cap is must,Coz hairs can block the filter.
I am attaching the time slot image with this post so u can enjoy your swim at your desired time.
They also have 2 slots for ladies only. But ladies don't worry you will find ur company in common timing too.

featured_reviews.name: Gopal Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing swimming pool maintained by a government organization in vasai. It has two sections, one for the children and one for adults. You will see kids who all are in the process of learning how to swim. Good place to swim with your friends. One can take their children for swimming, usually parents are not allowed inside with their children.

featured_reviews.name: prateek kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Size of the pool is very big separated as less deeper and deeper side..safe to learn swimming
U must have lycra material as swimming costume
Monthly pass available at vvmc office but they issue only 200 pass in e every 6 months but you can pay 50 rupees per hour.
Timing start from 5 o'clock in the morning till 8:30 in the evening every one hour there is 15 minute gap
Separate changing room for ladies and gents available and separate children and adult swimming areas

featured_reviews.name: Raju Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great place to swim.  4 to 8 (appx) feet deep. If you are going on weekdays it is good otherwise on weekends it's lil annoying. Guest entry is there for 50 Rs per hour. Guest nit allowed in 7.30am batch and in 10.30 am batch.
Starts on 5 am in morning and ends on 8.30 in evening.
Basic rules are
1. Swimming costume is mandatory
2. Sunday no diving
3. Before and after swim bath is mandate.

Overall good pool.

featured_reviews.name: anzil jose
featured_reviews.review_text:
Olympic sized swimming pool. Depth is up to 7.5 feet.
Water is clean and is changed regularly.
During the winter months they switch on the jacuzzi.
There is separate time for ladies.
First session starts at 5 in the morning.
There is a small pool for the kids .
